infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: This app requires Bluetooth access to discover and print receipt orders on thermal receipt printers.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: This app requires Bluetooth access to connect to thermal receipt printers.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: This app requires Local Network access to discover and print receipts on network printers (Epson TM-m30III).
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Krifoo Admin requires access to your photo library to allow store managers to upload dish photos, menu item images, restaurant logos, and receipt attachments.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Krifoo Admin requires camera access to allow store staff to photograph menu items and scan order verification QR codes.

plugins.bluetoothAlwaysPermission: Allow Krifoo Admin to connect to Bluetooth thermal printers.

plugins.photosPermission: Krifoo Admin requires access to your photo library to allow store managers to upload dish photos, menu item images, restaurant logos, and receipt attachments.
plugins.cameraPermission: Krifoo Admin requires camera access to allow store staff to photograph menu items and scan order verification QR codes.
